notes.title: [v1.3.14] 1/20 (Sat) update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Studio 215.
Thank you for playing Darkmatter: The Strange Messenger.

- Newly renewed animations for player characters. Animations are now smoother and judgments are more accurate overall.
- Added some background graphics.
- Fixed an issue where the buff could not be acquired again after checking the movement buff tooltip.
- Data load structure has been changed. The loading time for title entry has been reduced and the loading time for game entry has been increased.
- Boss monster attack detection has been improved.

We will continue to update as soon as new items are added or issues are discovered.
Thank you for your interest.

notes.title: A story about not being able to keep to the release schedule
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Studio 215.

First of all, I'm really sorry for not being able to meet the release date.

We are planning to proceed with a build review today or tomorrow.
Once the review is complete, we will confirm the release date and announce it immediately.

I had to tell you quickly.
As a result, I made an arrogant decision and made a fatal mistake.
Our first mission failed.
We will be quick and agile to prepare and bring you new announcements.

Do not suddenly come to mind, but try to talk about us.
Originally everything was ready for Dark Matter: The Strange Messenger.
The only thing left to do was to safely release the game into early access.
By the way, it's a word. A week ago, I made a big decision.
What was decided is that
I couldn't get rid of the idea that the game wouldn't be very interesting as it was.
Yes, it is. I had been doing my best to ignore the thoughts that had been growing in the back of my mind.
So it changed a lot of the game. That was a week ago.
That's really crazy!
The current situation has arisen.
Hmm..
I don't know if the new Dark Matter: The Strange Messenger will be an interesting game for you.
Still I find it more interesting than the previous build version.
I really want to release it as soon as possible and hear everyone's opinions.

This time, we will do our best to prepare so that we can release it without any special charges.

notes.title: Early Access Version Gameplay Reveal
notes.notes:
Hello, Strangers!

First and foremost, we hope you've been enjoying our demo.

During the Steam Next Fest, we really wanted to engage with you in real-time while you played the game. Unfortunately, we've been hard at work to meet the Early Access version release schedule, which made it impossible to have those real-time conversations, and we sincerely regret that.

To make up for not being able to show you more of what our demo version has to offer, we've recorded gameplay of our Early Access version. While the current demo version primarily showcases platforming elements, in this gameplay video, you'll get a glimpse of more action RPG aspects.

Since this is a recorded video, it may be difficult to answer questions in real-time in the chat. However, if you have any questions, please feel free to ask on our Discord channel, and we'll be sure to respond with the utmost sincerity.

We look forward to discussing and shaping the game with your valuable feedback.
Discord: https://discord.gg/hDyZNJJ36t

notes.title: Early Access Release on November 29th

notes.title: Dark Matter: The Strange Messenger, Update demo version
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Studio 215.

Thank you for playing the demo.
We updated the demo version to reflect the valuable feedback you provided in the last demo.

Update demo version
- Change the title screen image
- Npc Image Update: Each merchant dressed up.
- Less inside holes: Your stress is reduced now.
- Add Buff Storage (Attack Speed, Move Speed): For a short time, you can experience the highest speed.
- Improve directional operation when moving: You can now move more smoothly.
- Some UI/UX improvements

Users who installed the demo before September 25th should delete the demo and install the new demo and play it if the version at the bottom right of the title screen is not v1.1.6.


If you give an honest and free opinion through the demo questionnaire, it will be a great help to improve it to be a better game.
Questionnaire link: https://forms.gle/iR6oPmPXQctjre4z7

You can also play it on STEAM NEXT FAST from October 9 to October 16, 2023.

Discord: https://discord.gg/hDyZNJJ36t
